basic_info.description: New lower price! Two partially finished down to the studs remodeled two level flats delivered vacant and sold as-is. Use the permitted and approved plans or create something new. Extensive sesmic and foundation work has been completed. Endless opportunity to reconfigure and pick your finishes to suit your homeowner goals. Currently set up as two, two level flats with decks, large yard and city views.  Located in the Haight/Cole Valley neighborhood close to transportation, shopping Golden Gate Park and restaurants.
